title: Race condition for "Disable Forced Wear on Missed Readings"
symptom: If you are force collecting via Wear, and switch off your phone, when you turn it on again, if the time delta is greater than the 'Disable Forced Wear on Missed Readings' value, the phone will disable forced Wear before Wear can sync and backfill BG data collected while the phone was off.
cause: The phone disables forced Wear before Wear can sync and backfill BG data collected while the phone was off, due to the time delta exceeding the 'Disable Forced Wear on Missed Readings' threshold.
fix: The issue was reported to no longer happen in recent releases, but the user notes that often the phone struggles to pick up missed readings stored in the Wear DB for several cycles (or at all) without rebooting the phone and watch, and during that time it can pass the threshold for 'Disable Forced' and the phone tries to take over. No specific fix was provided.
evidence_quote: No doesn't seem to happen any more. However, often the phone struggles to pick up the missed readings stored in the Wear DB for several cycles (or at all) without rebooting the phone and watch.
